title: MHI Ships the Core of the H-IIA Launch Vehicle (H-IIA No.42) from Nagoya Aerospace Systems Works Tobishima Plant
excerpt: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has shipped the core of its H-IIA launch vehicle, carrying the #Emirates Mars Mission’s (EMM) “Hope” spacecraft, to the Tanegashima #Space Center for launch preparations. Read more:…
body:
Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has shipped the core of its H-IIA launch vehicle, carrying the #Emirates Mars Mission’s (EMM) “Hope” spacecraft, to the Tanegashima #Space Center for launch preparations.
